profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of designing and implementing robust and scalable web applications and RESTful services. Skilled programmer with experience in Java, Javascript frameworks, SQL Database, test-driven development & Agile practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed services that allow physicians to efficiently document patients’ prognosis, test results and diagnosis.
• Designed RESTful services for cloud-based Cerner Millennium+ platform which is utilized by a third-party developer and Cerner solutions. Used various authentication techniques like OAuth1 and OAuth2 in RESTful services.
• Implemented RESTful services to save and retrieve various types of documents for patients. Also developed services that allow interoperability of services with other health care systems.
• Worked with clients and internal teams to troubleshoot service-related performance issues, defect corrections that span multiple modules
• Worked using agile methodology on projects emphasizing teamwork, frequent deliveries, and customer collaboration, requirement gathering, technical design up to deployment.
• Participated in end-to-end agile workflow including requirements gathering, designing architecture, code reviews, and writing test plans.
• Performed responsibilities of a Quality Engineering like regression, behavior-driven testing, and automated testing using frameworks like Junit, JBehave, and Gatling.
• Propose and lead process improvements projects for development, deployment, and application monitoring
• Share knowledge within the team through mentorship, coaching, technical talks, and blogs. Participate in code reviews and identify basic issues or deviations from best practices     

Tools & Technologies: Java, Maven, JUnit, JBehave, Git, Jenkins, Apache Tomcat, Docker, Splunk, New Relic, Oracle Database

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Designed Front-end components with React JS and Redux which represents and captures dynamic data and documents.
• Developed PL/SQL procedure to handle complex retrieval and insert transactions in SQL tables as per input
• Designed RESTful Web API(s) for handling dynamic entities and CRUD operations with JWT authentication middleware
• Implemented UOW pattern for database handling through express js.
• Technologies: NodeJS, React JS, Redux, express, Oracle 11g

positions.title: Intramural Official
positions.description:
• Officiate volleyball and cricket games at Intramural sports.
• Assist with events organized by Intramural Sports and Lamar University Recreational Sports.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Provided abstraction layer using Hibernate framework between controller and database access layer of an existing web application of human resource and customer relationship management (HRM and CRM). 
• Developed customer feedback system, complaint management system.
• Delivered web application to multiple clients who were using different database technologies such as MySQL, Oracle.
• Technologies: J2EE, Servlet, HTML, Bootstrap, CSS, JavaScript, Hibernate, JSP, JSTL, Eclipse IDE

projects.title: 3D Slot Machine – Android Game
projects.description:
•Designed 3D model of slot machine using Lightwave 3D software and converted it to gx3dBin format to integrate into Android Application. 
•Used OpenGL class to render 3D model. 
•Added cheat to win every third-time play.

projects.title: Nicky The Fish
projects.description: •Android Game based on famous Tamagotchi digital toy.
